column1: # How the 48GX types each character into its command line: code, method, keys.
# Generated by crates/saturnus-web/tests/typing.rs from the ROM; do not edit.
# alpha: the keys in alpha mode; pair:O,C: they insert O and C around the cursor;
# entry: the keys in program entry mode, alpha off (the first non-space they insert);
# accent:B: character B, then the keys; chars: the CHARS application; none: no way.
